decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal is for the erection of a two-storey side extension and a single storey rear extension to the house. It is considered that the bulk, scale, and appearance of the impact of the extensions would not result in any significant adverse impacts upon the amenity of the existing site, and the adjoining and neighbouring properties. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and a single storey rear extension to the house
